fields.Name: T077 - Configure View Smart Filter Mode
fields.Description: Smart Filter (AI/natural-language) is a separate filter branch from the Traditional field/operator/value builder that the existing advanced-filter test covers.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Products', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Open Configure View (the sliders / sliders-h icon in the view toolbar near the saved-view selector). Click the 'Filters' tab. It offers a filter-mode selector with two choices: 'Smart Filter' (natural language) and 'Traditional Filter'. Choose 'Smart Filter'. Success is the smart-filter UI rendering: a natural-language description textarea plus example chips (e.g. 'Last 30 days', 'Active only'). Seeing the smart-filter input render is success — you do NOT need to type a prompt or run it.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Configure View panel opens and the Filters tab shows a Smart vs Traditional filter-mode selector
Selecting 'Smart Filter' reveals a natural-language textarea and example prompt chips
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
